title: ReCom TCG commander pairings
description: Pair variants (RN-04). Two cards pair when one matches side a, the other side b, and both give the same key.

text_line.description: A line of Oracle text that says exactly this, without case.

text_pattern.description: A regex matched against each line of Oracle text; its (?<key>…) group is the pairing key.

type_all.description: Words the type line must all contain.

own_name.description: The key is the card's own name.

solo.description: Cards matched by this side cannot be commander alone.
